development_selection.gate: Select the current evidence adjustment only when development-set nDCG@K and Kendall tau-b both improve over median potency, both paired 95% interval lower bounds exceed zero, and both two-sided score-swap p-values are below 0.05.

partition_contract: stratified deterministic SHA-256 of seed:molecule_id; no assay outcomes or scores
temporal_contract: latest publication year held out; training publications are strictly earlier and document-disjoint
